traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose a dragon type (Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, or White). This determines your Breath Weapon damage type and Damage Resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line (5 feet wide) breath. Each creature makes a Dexterity save (DC = 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus). Fail: 1d10 damage of your ancestry type; Success: half. Scales: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17. Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus; recharge on Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, as a Bonus Action you sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes, gaining a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes while on or touching a stone surface. Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus; recharge on Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet (Drow lineage extends this to 120 feet).

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose a lineage: Drow (Darkvision 120 ft, Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire at level 3; Darkness at level 5), High Elf (Prestidigitation cantrip, swap each Long Rest; Detect Magic at level 3; Misty Step at level 5), or Wood Elf (Speed 35, Druidcraft cantrip; Longstrider at level 3; Pass without Trace at level 5). Spell DC uses your chosen INT, WIS, or CHA.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill (your choice).

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose a lineage. Forest Gnome: Minor Illusion cantrip + Speak with Animals (always prepared, cast without slot equal to Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest). Rock Gnome: Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips + can craft a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) with 10 min casting; up to 3 devices exist at once, falling apart after 8 hours. Spell DC uses your chosen INT, WIS, or CHA.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose one supernatural benefit (uses equal to Proficiency Bonus; recharge Long Rest): Cloud's Jaunt — teleport 30 ft as Bonus Action; Fire's Burn — deal +1d10 Fire damage on a hit; Frost's Chill — deal +1d6 Cold damage on a hit and reduce Speed by 10 ft until your next turn; Hill's Tumble — give Prone condition to a Large or smaller creature on a hit; Stone's Endurance — Reaction to roll 1d12 + CON modifier and reduce incoming damage by that total; Storm's Thunder — Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder to a creature within 60 ft that damaged you.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, as a Bonus Action you change your size to Large for 10 minutes (if space allows), gaining Advantage on Strength checks and +10 ft Speed. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but can't stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Skilled is recommended.

traits.size_note: Choose Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall) when you select this species.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus; recharge on Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose a legacy: Abyssal (Poison Resistance; Poison Spray cantrip; Ray of Sickness at level 3; Hold Person at level 5), Chthonic (Necrotic Resistance; Chill Touch cantrip; False Life at level 3; Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5), or Infernal (Fire Resistance; Fire Bolt cantrip; Hellish Rebuke at level 3; Darkness at level 5). Spell DC uses your chosen INT, WIS, or CHA.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using the same spellcasting ability as your Fiendish Legacy trait.

traits.size_note: Choose Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 3-4 feet tall) when you select this species.
